title: CodeAtlas v0.1 Initial Cockpit & Deterministic Verifier
author: antigravity
summary: Initial validation build implementing the VS Code Cockpit extension, Git reader, deterministic briefing verifier, and Gate B CLI.

blockingConditions.condition: Claimed line range exceeds actual file line count or symbol is missing
blockingConditions.outcome: Anchor and claim are marked MISMATCH rather than VERIFIED

blockingConditions.condition: Briefing targetRef differs from current Git HEAD
blockingConditions.outcome: Evidence is flagged as STALE so stale reviews cannot be mistaken for current state

claims.title: Deterministic briefing verifier entry
claims.statement: verifyBriefing resolves targetRef, checks staleness against HEAD, and validates every claim anchor against Git/worktree files.

claims.title: VS Code Cockpit registers activity bar webview and commands
claims.statement: Extension activation registers codeatlas.cockpit webview provider plus openCockpit and verifyBriefing commands.

claims.title: Directives export format
claims.statement: Annotations are serialized into a Git-ref-bound Markdown directive document for Agent rework.

verificationSignals.description: Verified valid anchors, hallucinated symbols/line ranges, and stale ref detection against temporary Git repos.
Strict TypeScript compilation passes with zero errors.

blindSpots: Symbol matching currently uses line-window text checks rather than full AST/LSP resolution.
Interactive VS Code Extension Development Host UI behavior requires manual verification in VS Code.
